text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm participating in an immersive
escape room with Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Mhm, mhm. To go any further,
'Seek out the Hermit who chases carrots.'
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The painting directly opposite the vegetable still life... in the section showing the person facing straight forward—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes! I found the switch!
choice_data_list: Man, you're solving these with no trouble at all.
You're really breezing through these, huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this much is nothing.
Let's keep this momentum going
and move on to the next room!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye's sharp deductions continued to shine after that, clearing room after room with ease.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I see. Reading counterclockwise, we get '4', 't', 'h', 'L'—
So the fourth candlestick from the left is the switch!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If I drive pins into this hole, and this one...
Ah, it opened! I'm really sharp today!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Still, sorry about that. I just got carried away and kept solving them all on my own."
choice_data_list: None of that matters as long as you're having fun.
None of that matters as long as you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks!
Well then—keeping this momentum going,
I'll aim to answer every single question right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—we finally reached
the final room, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Hmm. I solved the cipher and completed the hint phrase, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's odd. If it's like this,
the password to open the door becomes 'Eggplant Kingdom'...
There's no way it'd be such a joke out of nowhere—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, hold on a second. Don't tell me
I got the method for solving the cipher completely wrong from the start...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ironically, right before clearing it, Almond Eye's thoughts hit a dead end... and slowly, the remaining time ticks away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... even more ironically,
despite having left all the riddle-solving to Almond Eye up until now—
choice_data_list: (...I actually know the answer to this one question.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However—I just encouraged them to solve everything
on their own. For me to answer the final question
of all things would be—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...? What's wrong, Trainer?
You've been fidgeting for a while now—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Could it be,
you figured out the answer?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Don't you get it now?!
choice_data_list: ...Then, would it be okay if I tried answering?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Sorry, don't tell me yet!
Just a little more... I'm almost there...!
Let's see...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!? Oh, I get it! The cipher letters are
color-coded, so... like this, like that—
and if I rearrange them here...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Got it! The answer is—

text_block_list.name: Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"—Time's up!
Game Over right here!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: ...In the end, our answer was right after all.
...In the end, our answer was right after all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
…………
Um... I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Do you know of any place with as few people as possible?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Damn it allllll!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: And here I thought I had it...! Just a few more seconds... and I would've beaten it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—And besides... Trainer already understood.
If only I had just cooperated honestly...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I was being stubborn,
insisting I had to solve it all on my own...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
……I won't…… lose anymore! To that version of myself……
I'm never gonna lose ever agaaaain!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: Let's use this frustration as fuel to grow.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I appreciate it, but I don't need it.
Comfort like that—
choice_data_list: Still... isn't your throat dry from all that shouting?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
I think I will take you up on your kindness after all.
If I let my stubbornness get the better of me, it'll just be like before."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a day that offered a glimpse of Almond Eye—normally so dependable—acting a bit more her age.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*. How embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was handling things well myself.
Turns out, I was just getting ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I need to get my act together.
Keep my feet on the ground—so I can overcome this wall."
